model: Heteroscedastic conditional logistic mixture density; ensemble CDF median
task_rationale: All three MAE tasks have meaningful original confirmation scaffold coverage, larger normalized-score sensitivity, and regression-to-center tail errors in both development folds. Excludes single-group AMES and highly concentrated LD50/solubility confirmation. No failed confirmation is used to choose configurations.
distinct_from_completed_routes: Learns conditional mixture probabilities/locations/scales via likelihood and reports median of combined CDF. Earlier point MAE/RMSE, scalar splines, quantile forest, factorization and attention did not estimate heteroscedastic mixture density. Not a retry or new seed of a rejected source; no prior model/prediction inputs.
features: Six independent L2-normalized logcount fingerprint views, fit-only physical/shape/pharmacophore and target-excluded measured-context scaling/missingness. Medians/centers/scales computed on fit only.
network: 6x24 fingerprint branches, physical96/context32, concatenated272->128->64->9. SiLU,LayerNorm,dropout.1. Three logits,unbounded standardized locations,softplus scale+.03. Fixed weak scale penalty .0001.
training: 2 fixed seeds; AdamW .0008/weight_decay.02, cosine .00003, batch128,clip5;120epochs clipped1000..3500steps. Negative logistic-mixture loglikelihood; no query-based early stop.
inference: Deterministic CPUfloat64: combine two three-component CDFs with equal seed mass; 64-step bisection median, convert using fit-only native scale. No mean of separate model medians.
scheduling: One GPU worker owns3tasks/6development partitions/12seedmodels,4CPUthreads. After exit0 unchanged v148 selection freezes config and weight before confirmation.
selection: Unchanged: max minimum fold0/1 gain > .012 for MAE, unique config and .2/.45 blend frozen.
verification: ConditionalCDF against independent scipy root;affine equivariance;3task CUDAfinite gradients/training step,nonfitlabel perturbation,savedmodelCPUreplay,roworder. Accepted tasks independent full feature reconstruction/reload/gates/fusion/bytes/hashes/archive.
limitations: Repeated public-label reuse and approximate historical upstream controls. Tail errors may be unavoidable or data-limited; conditional density is a hypothesis, not promised improvement. No hidden score guarantee.
